evidence.chaos: She mostly stays within bounds, but occasionally pushes—though hesitantly: 'You're going to be...this close to getting sent home'
evidence.heroism: She uses Hold Person strategically to paralyze enemies and protect the group: 'paralyzed. He's hold the person. Um, so enjoy your free crits.'
evidence.comedy: She makes a few light jokes: 'Two of us are all in on that. Yeah, we've got Scarlet, don't you have a port tint to turn it into Nocrret?'
evidence.immersion: Maintains character play but with some detachment: 'Okay, that's fine. Yeah, I know I debated also holding what's her name, too'
evidence.strategy: Makes tactical decisions with Hold Person and positioning: 'I want to target with this... I'm going to upcast it. So, can what's her name also give me one?'
evidence.curiosity: Asks moderate questions about the scenario: 'Is Bru in the break room still?' and 'Isn't he in prison?'

evidence.chaos: Drives the Tacoma through the facility to block doors, casts spells recklessly, and generally escalates: 'I'm gonna try to drive the Tacoma and if I can also sideswipe Dinland'
evidence.heroism: Attempts to protect others and confront the COO: 'Oh, hey, Bru. Are you um you going to stay janitor now that the cameras are gone?'
evidence.comedy: Consistently lands jokes and funny moments: 'Well, jokes's on you. I am a wizard.' and the whole Scarlet existential crisis bit gets laughs
evidence.immersion: Strong character voice and decisions: 'Scarlet opens it up and spits in it' and uses actions to embody the character
evidence.strategy: Makes some tactical choices but often impulsive: 'I'm going to burn a second level spell slot to cast it in this green room'
evidence.curiosity: Investigates the blueprints and cipher: 'I think Scarlet would be really interested in like trying to decipher the technology'

evidence.chaos: Consistently pushes boundaries and derails into murder: 'Let's just kill her.' and 'Every camera in this place gets the same treatment.'
evidence.heroism: Commits to the mission despite frustration and protects the group tactically: 'I'm paralyzed. That's miserable.' but continues fighting effectively
evidence.comedy: Sharp, cutting humor often at others' expense: 'I feel like Silence would go all the way and just kill them' and 'Silas kills Iron Claws on sight.'
evidence.immersion: Deep engagement with character voice and motivations: 'Silas bends down and whispers into the ironclaw's ear, I'm going to do this to every f****** one of you.'
evidence.strategy: Drives most tactical decisions with forethought: 'I'm going to position I'm going to walk straight above the iron claw and just like drop down with like a dagger'
evidence.curiosity: Asks pointed questions to understand situations: 'How far away are they from me? Okay. Um, I'm going to start off by uh chucking a dagger'

evidence.chaos: Creates elaborate setups that cause mayhem: 'Bru tried to direct us to go into this like hidden al cove' and coordinates explosions and camera destruction
evidence.heroism: Helps the party and reveals himself as a key ally: 'All right. He uh he takes his hat off and like pops it and then puts it back on and he turns into his like normal Colonel Sanders.'
evidence.comedy: The comedic engine of the session with consistent funny moments and voices: 'I don't know. It's your phone, dude.' and the whole Bru reveal at the end is played for laughs
evidence.immersion: Maintains character consistency and uses distinct voices: 'Oh yeah. Carlo, this is Bru. Um, Bru. Why are you being so condescending on that?'
evidence.strategy: Plans elaborate scenarios and coordinates multiple elements: 'So, uh Silas is the one that can recognize that these names are the same names that you've seen from the F-150'
evidence.curiosity: Introduces information and clues throughout: 'So, when I clicked on it on Discord, it made it smaller instead of bigger.'

mvp.quote: I'm going to position I'm going to walk straight above the iron claw and just like drop down with like a dagger drawn like so that my dagger just like lands straight into the top of their head and it's a free it's an auto crit...Uh 78 psychic damage. Um, Braa drops.

best_joke.quote: It was me the whole time. [pulls off janitor disguise] No, you didn't. It was a masterful disguise and you knew nothing.

most_chaotic.quote: Every camera in this place gets the same treatment. Go. [later] I feel like Silence would go all the way and just kill them.
